title: JayBase
excerpt: The data store where it's safe for your AI agents to have write access.
content_html:
The data store where it's safe for your AI agents to have write access.

You want agents doing real work on company data, not just generating insights. JayBase keeps an append-only, attributed history, so every write is saved and corrections are new events.

Create accountHow the tech works

Why write access can stay usable

A bad agent write can poison the data you trust if history disappears. Hosted JayBase is an append-only, attributed store with a built-in UI so you can browse what agents wrote.

Agents can work on sensitive data, and you can inspect their writes without digging through terminal logs. When a write goes wrong, you catch it in the UI and correct it as a new event. The past stays in the record.

How JayBase actually works

Giving agents write access needs a store that keeps history. Here is a short look at how JayBase handles agent writes.

What can you do with it?

Use JayBase as the place where agents write the company data behind real work.

  1. Bookkeeping

    Agents post ledger entries, bills, and payments into records your team can open and verify.

  2. Storing customer data

    Agents create and update customer profiles in one place you can browse and update directly.

  3. Inventory

    Agents adjust stock counts and item records as operations move, without scattering numbers across tools.

  4. Job tracking

    Agents log jobs, status updates, and notes you can track and update as the work progresses.

From $20 per JayBase per month. See pricing.
